1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable letter and line spacing.

2.why: Instructions use sentence case with no italics, all-caps, or dense paragraphs.

3.why: The UI is a single-column mobile-width layout with readable text and large controls.

4.why: Copy such as 'Confirm it is you' and 'Set up your authenticator' is short and in plain language.

5.why: Demo credentials and a recovery-code placeholder (ABCD-EFGH-JKLM) give some format hints, but confirmation and OTP fields show no example input.

6.why: Core instructions are brief, though the long provisioning URI is shown as a dense block the user may still confront.

7.why: Setup key and URI appear selectable, but there are no copy buttons and recovery codes are separate chips without a copy-all control.

8.why: No QR code is shown on authenticator setup; only a manual setup key and provisioning URI text are offered.

9.why: Login uses standard email/password fields that often support autofill, but this cannot be confirmed and OTP fields show no autofill cues.

10.why: Clear headings and prominent blue primary buttons highlight the main action, but no step/progress indicator is present.

11.why: Each screen asks for a single primary task with one main call-to-action.

12.why: Messages like 'Authenticator enabled' and 'Recovery code accepted and permanently used' state outcomes, though next-step guidance is sometimes thin.

13.why: Recovery codes can be regenerated and sign-in retried without penalty, but no resend-code or reveal/hide controls are visible.

14.why: The error 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' does not say what failed or how to fix it beyond retrying.

15.why: No countdown timers or reading/entry time limits appear on any screen in the flow.
